In today's episode of The Daily Brief, we cover two stories shaping Indian and global markets:
Story 1: The Fall of Microsoft Xbox
Microsoft spent billions on acquisitions and Game Pass to revive Xbox, but strategic mistakes, weak exclusives, and the economics of subscription gaming have left its gaming business under pressure. We explain how one of the biggest names in tech ended up struggling in the console wars.
